evidence: The paper evaluates Cox and random survival forest models using C-index and Integrated Brier Score (IBS)—predictive performance metrics, not variable importance. No impurity-based importance scores are extracted or reported. Variable selection uses univariate Cox p-values for pre-filtering 2500 genes (Section 2.2.2), not forest importance. All conclusions address aggregate prediction performance: Cox vs RF comparison, miRNA vs mRNA predictive value, sequencing depth optimization, and sample size requirements. Results are validated using cross-validation and external held-out validation on an independent dataset (E-MTAB-1980; Section 3.8).
